summary: Added Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) transforms. Lambda takes an optional callable (TypeError if not callable) and passes input through when func is None; it also accepts a per-call func override. Lambdad applies the function to each listed key on a copied dict. Added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst and tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run or committed: tests and code were verified by reading only.
